sql: SELECT CAST((MAX(T1.screentime) - MIN(T1.screentime)) AS REAL) * 100 / MIN(T1.screentime) FROM characters AS T1 INNER JOIN movie AS T2 ON T1.MovieID = T2.MovieID WHERE T2.Title = 'Batman'
SELECT T1.Name FROM actor AS T1 INNER JOIN characters AS T2 ON T1.ActorID = T2.ActorID INNER JOIN movie AS T3 ON T2.MovieID = T3.MovieID WHERE T3."Release Date" = '2015-10-26' AND T2.creditOrder = 1

SELECT T1."Character Name" FROM characters AS T1 INNER JOIN actor AS T2 ON T1.ActorID = T2.ActorID INNER JOIN movie AS T3 ON T1.MovieID = T3.MovieID WHERE T2.Gender = 'Female' AND T3.Title = 'Bruce Almighty' AND T2."Birth City" = 'Sherman Oaks' AND T2."Height (Inches)" > (SELECT AVG("Height (Inches)") * 0.5 FROM actor)
